necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent dizziness consistent with a history of sick sinus syndrome (I49.5) and supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1). Due to the sporadic nature of these symptoms, a cardiac event monitoring study (CPT 93271) is ordered to capture rhythm disturbances and correlate clinical events with electrocardiographic findings. This service is medically necessary to address the specific diagnostic needs out.
